scope: runner-local replacement of the cross-module postprocess-ready term on the MAC result acknowledge path
proof_basis: In every known-state MAC_WAIT row, state is not IDLE, therefore table_enable=0 and child_table_valid=0 regardless of parent table_valid, start, or export_start. Expanding child_fault gives the remaining child_input_ready factors exactly.
preserved: known-state handshakes, II and cycle counts
four_state_boundary: The Python proof is two-state. State or control X/Z values can produce unknowns through Verilog equality, relational, logical and cross-module expressions; no equivalence claim is made for those rows until focused four-state RTL checks and static inspection pass. Synthesized hardware is two-state, but simulation X behavior remains a diagnostic contract.
